transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um, hi. I guess I’m here because I’ve been having some trouble with eating, mostly when I’m by myself. It’s not every second or anything, but after work or class I’ll sit down with my laptop and I’ll mean to just have dinner, and then I end up eating a whole takeout meal and then chips or sweets and whatever snacks I have in my desk drawer.

It feels like… more than I planned, and definitely more than I’d eat if someone else were there. I’m not sure if that’s the kind of thing you mean, but it’s been worrying me a bit.
Do you feel guilty after eating those extra snacks?

I mean… maybe a little? I don’t know if I’d call it guilt exactly. Sometimes I kind of think, “Why did I do that?” and feel embarrassed, but I also try not to make a huge deal out of it. Is that what you mean?
Do you feel like you can stop eating once you've started, or does it feel like you're unable to control how much you eat?

Yeah… I guess that’s the part that worries me. I don’t want to make it sound dramatic, but once I start, it can feel like I’m sort of watching myself keep reaching for the next thing, even while I’m thinking, “Jaime, stop, you have a budget report to finish,” or like, “You’re not even enjoying this anymore.”  

So… yes, I think sometimes it does feel like I can’t really control how much I’m eating, at least in the moment.
Do you feel like you're in control of what you're eating when these episodes happen?

Not really, no… I mean, I’m choosing to eat, so it feels weird to say I have no control, but once I start it’s like I’m watching myself keep reaching for the next thing. I’ll be thinking, “Jaime, stop, you have a budget report to finish,” or “You’re not even enjoying this anymore,” and I still keep going. Does that make sense?
How often do these episodes of eating more than you planned happen?

Um… I guess it’s not just occasional. I actually looked back at my journal and some food delivery charges because I wasn’t sure if I was exaggerating, and it looks like it’s been happening most weeks since the restructuring started. Usually more than once a week, honestly. I don’t know if that’s the kind of frequency you mean, but… yeah, not just here and there.
Do these episodes of eating more than you planned cause you significant stress or affect your daily life in any way?

I mean… I’m still getting work and school done, so I don’t want to make it sound like my whole life is falling apart or anything. But yeah, it has affected things.

I’ve been kind of avoiding plans with friends or family, especially things like cooking nights or eating together, because I’m worried they’ll somehow notice how much I’ve been eating when I’m by myself. So I’ve been more isolated outside of work and school than I usually am. I don’t know if that counts as “significant,” but it does stress me out.
Do you feel like you're completely unable to stop eating once you've started, even if you want to?

Yeah… I mean, “completely unable” sounds so dramatic, and I don’t want to overstate it, but it really does feel that way in the moment.

Once I start, it’s like I’m watching myself keep reaching for the next thing, even while I’m thinking, Jaime, stop, you have that budget report to finish, or you’re not even enjoying this anymore. And I still keep going. So… yes, I think so.
Do you enjoy the taste or experience of eating during these episodes?

At first, maybe for a little bit… like the first few bites can feel good, I guess. But pretty quickly it’s not really about enjoying it.

It’s more like once I start, I’m just watching myself keep reaching for the next thing, even while I’m thinking, Jaime, stop, you have that budget report to finish, you’re not even enjoying this anymore. So… no, not really. Not in the way I think you mean.
Do you feel like you're eating really quickly during these episodes?

Um… I’m not totally sure, honestly. I haven’t really paid close attention to the speed of it.

I guess it can feel kind of automatic, but I don’t know if that means I’m eating “really quickly” compared to normal. Sorry, is that an okay answer? I just don’t want to guess and say yes if I’m not sure.
Do you think you're eating more quickly than usual during these episodes?

I… I don’t really know. I’m sorry, I feel like that should be easy to answer, but I haven’t paid attention to whether it’s faster than usual.

It feels kind of… not normal, I guess, but I can’t honestly say if that means I’m eating more quickly. Is it okay if I’m not sure?
Do you think you're eating really quickly during these episodes, to the point where you're not even chewing or tasting the food?

I don’t think I can say that, no… or at least I haven’t noticed it that clearly.

Like, it can feel kind of disconnected, but I don’t remember thinking, “I’m not chewing,” or “I can’t taste this.” I’m sorry, I know you’re trying to get specifics — I just don’t want to make it sound more dramatic than it is if I’m not sure.
Do you think these episodes where you eat more than you planned and feel like you can't stop are what people typically mean by 'binge eating'?

I mean… maybe? I don’t want to label it wrong, but the part that does fit is that once I start, it’s like I keep reaching for the next thing even while part of me is thinking, Jaime, stop, you have that budget report to finish… and I’m not even really enjoying it anymore.

So, I guess if that’s what you mean by it — eating more than I meant to and feeling like I can’t pull myself out of it — then… yeah, that does sound like what’s happening. Is that the kind of thing you’re asking about?
